review: Yesterday the blade assembly on my AeroBlend 500 Blender came loose while it was running and the glass jar shattered across the counter. My daughter was standing right beside it. Nobody was cut, thankfully, but I am quite shaken. - Deepa Menon

Hello, I think there has been a mistake with my order. My bank statement shows that I was charged Rs. 18,999 twice for one PixelView 27 Monitor. Could someone please look into this when they get a chance? Thank you.
My TrailMate Backpack never turned up. I have written to you four times since the start of last month and phoned twice, and every time I am told somebody will get back to me. Nobody has.

After two days of wearing the SoundLoop Earbuds, both my ears became swollen and painful with a rash where the tips sit. I had to see a doctor, who told me to stop using them. I am not sure what material the tips are made of. - Nikhil

I really like the AeroBlend 500 Blender. It is powerful, easy to clean and looks great in my kitchen. One thing I should mention: last week I got a small electric shock from the base when I touched it with damp hands. It has been fine since, so overall I am still happy with it. - Ritu
ABSOLUTELY RIDICULOUS!!! The box my BreezeMax Tower Fan came in had a big dent in one corner. The fan itself works, but is this how you treat your customers' orders?!
I want to speak to a manager. The VoltCharge 20W Charger I received is off-white, and on your website it is clearly shown as pure white. - Mrs. Kapoor
There is one dead pixel in the bottom corner of my PixelView 27 Monitor. It is small, but I notice it on a white background. I would like to exchange it if that is possible.

I have used the TrailMate Backpack on three weekend hikes now. The padding is excellent, it sits well on my back and the side pockets fit a one-litre bottle. The little pull tab on the front zip came off on the second trip, which was a shame, but the zip still works. - Aditya
My father is 78 and depends on his BreezeMax Tower Fan in this heat. It stopped working after three days. Is there any way to get this sorted out quickly for him?

This is the third time I have ordered from you and the third time something small has been wrong. This time the VoltCharge 20W Charger came without its instruction leaflet. It is not a disaster, but it does make me wonder.
